text: # Engineering Team PTO Policy ## Previous Policy (through Dec 31, 2025) Full-time engineers accrued 18 days of paid time off per year, credited monthly at 1.5 days per month. Unused PTO could roll over up to 5 days into the next calendar year. Engineers were asked to coordinate time off with their team lead in advance to avoid gaps in on-call coverage. ## Updated Policy (effective Jan 1, 2026) Starting January 1, 2026, full-time engineers accrue 22 days of paid time off per year, credited monthly at approximately 1.83 days per month. The rollover cap remains at 5 days. On-call coordination requirements are unchanged. This update was approved as part of the annual engineering retention review. ## Summary of the Change The Engineering team's annual PTO allowance increased from 18 days to 22 days — a gain of 4 days per year, roughly a 22% increase.
